steps: Serve a prod build of the round-206 tree; run node c-round-206/tools/cprobe.cjs http://127.0.0.1:<port> out.json (pass 3 also drags Volume — Music and Pan — Music while playing at 6x CPU)
Read eventNamesMaxDur and inputEvents per drag; read *.event-share-16.* rows in c-round-206/out/run1.json and run2.json
bugs.expected: event-share-16 (budget note: share < 5 % <=> p95 < 16 ms; PERF-FADER will flip it to assert) can report a slow fader drag as non-zero, and doc 163 l.60 states its real limit
bugs.actual: Event Timing entries during drags are only pointerover/enter/out, mouseover/out, pointerdown, pointerup, click (no pointermove); the faders fire 0 native input events during a mouse drag; so the pointermove|input filter matches nothing. All 20 event-share-16 rows are 0 in both runs, incl. clipgain.playing.6x with frame p95 66.7 ms, 136-147 frames >33 ms, 74 LoAF. Doc 163 l.60 and a-round-206.md claim it is effectively the share of native range input entries, which is false. Asserting it would pass vacuously. Harness/spec issue, not an app bug; severity for B to rule. Origins: (a) spec: metric defined by B in R111 (task §0 knew 0 pointermove entries); (b) doc: A added the false limit sentence at doc 163 l.60; budgets.json event-share notes carry the same equivalence. Neither blocks round-206 PASS (record row; all C criteria met).
bugs.evidence: c-round-206/out/cprobe-1440.json; c-round-206/out/run1.json, run2.json (details slowEvents 0, eventEntries 26); c-round-206.md C-R206-01
